name: Emma Luu Van Lang
description:
Emma Luu Van Lang is Head of the Geneva Research Lab for Digital Impact (GRL) at the University of Geneva, a research and impact platform advancing inclusive and sustainable digital transformation. With over a decade of experience in international development and social impact, she leads GRL’s strategy and initiatives, bridging research, policy and practice to understand what it takes for digital innovation to deliver meaningful societal impact.

GRL’s work focuses on the human, institutional and ecosystem conditions that enable digital infrastructure and emerging technologies to deliver impact beyond their technical design, including the factors shaping their adoption, governance and long-term sustainability. Through research, learning and cross-sector collaboration, GRL translates evidence into practical solutions and helps inform decisions that support the responsible and inclusive adoption and scaling of digital innovations.
